'''Cold Front''' is the 34th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on January 12, 2018. The set consists of 56 cards. This set is part of the ''Enterprise Block'' consisting of cards from [[Broken Bow]], [[Pre-Warp Pack]], [[Live Long and Prosper (expansion)|Live Long and Prosper]], [[Cold Front (expansion)|Cold Front]], and [[Enterprise Collection Remastered (expansion)|Enterprise Collection Remastered]] expansion sets.

==Type Breakdown==
*4 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*8 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*2 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (Station)  (2 Non-Aligned)
*6 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*2 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*2 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*23 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (3 Federation, 2 Klingon, 12 Non-Aligned, 6 Romulan, and 2 Starfleet)
*6 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Federation, 2 Ferengi, 3 Non-Aligned and 2 Romulan)
*1 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
